McLennan North is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 143 homes sold there: 5 houses, 49 condos and 87 townhomes. 87 townhomes sold in McLennan North with a median price of $1,093,000 (the middle half sold between $995,000 and $1,262,900), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 5% sold above list.
McLennan North home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

87 townhomes sold in McLennan North with a median price of $1,093,000 (the middle half sold between $995,000 and $1,262,900), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $753 per square foot, a median year built of 2010 and a median strata fee of $405 a month. 49 condos sold in McLennan North with a median price of $581,000 (the middle half sold between $490,000 and $648,000), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $714 per square foot, a median year built of 2007 and a median strata fee of $489 a month.

items.t: The plan names Garden City Road (west), No. 4 Road (east, next to agricultural land), Westminster Highway, Cook Road and Alberta Road; its exact boundary appears only on a map not readable in the text.
The plan's community park and school site has frontages on Granville Avenue, No. 4 Road and Alberta Road.
The plan calls for single-family homes, townhouses and apartments, with apartments up to 45 m along Garden City Road and lower townhouse and single- and two-family forms toward No. 4 Road.
The plan's land use map was amended in 2022, and a 2022 bylaw redesignated 9511 Granville Avenue as School.

blocks.text: McLennan North: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: The plan requires a community park and school site of at least 83,000 m2, two neighbourhood parks of at least 0.71 ha each, and a public trail at least 5 m wide on the east side of Garden City Road.
MacNeill Neighbourhood School Park, 6611 No. 4 Road, covers 20.36 acres with sports fields, a track and a community garden.
A mixed-use area at Cook and Alberta Roads is planned as the gateway to the park.
A.R. MacNeill Secondary is the secondary school beside that park.
Catchments are set by the SD38 Board; use the SD38 locator.
The plan proposes a local shuttle bus and does not mention a Canada Line station.

faq.q: What did townhomes in McLennan North sell for?
faq.a: 87 townhomes sold in McLennan North between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,093,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in McLennan North?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.1% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in McLennan North sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 87 townhomes that sold in McLennan North went for between $995,000 and $1,262,900, around a median of $1,093,000.

faq.q: Do townhomes in McLennan North sell above asking price?
faq.a: 5% of the 87 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.1% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in McLennan North?
faq.a: Of the 87 sales, 86 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $405.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in McLennan North?
faq.a: The median year built was 2010 for the 87 townhomes sold in McLennan North.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in McLennan North usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in McLennan North had 3 bedrooms, from the 87 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
